title: Custom role with 0 users assigned deletes successfully via three-dot menu
role_used: Admin deleting ZZAUTOTEST Delete OK (0 users)
expected: Three-dot menu shows Delete; confirmation dialog appears; after confirm the row disappears
actual: Created ZZAUTOTEST Delete OK (0 users). Its three-dot menu showed 'View Permissions' + 'Delete'. Clicked Delete, a confirm action was required and completed; green toast 'Role deleted successfully.' appeared and the row disappeared from the list (verified via re-search).
reason: 0-user custom role deletes via the three-dot menu Delete with confirmation; row removed and success toast shown.

title: Custom role with 1+ users cannot be deleted (spec: Cannot Delete modal)
role_used: Admin on ZZAUTOTEST Delete Blocked (Tech assigned, 1 user)
expected: Per spec: a 'Cannot Delete' modal appears ('This role is assigned to N user(s). Reassign them...') with confirm disabled
actual: Created ZZAUTOTEST Delete Blocked with Tech assigned (1 user). No 'Cannot Delete' modal exists. Deletion is prevented two ways exactly as the case body documents: (1) the list three-dot menu hides the Delete item (shows only 'View Permissions'); (2) the editor 'Delete Role' button (data-test-id=delete_role_edit) is disabled with message 'This role is assigned to 1 user(s). Reassign them to another role before deleting.'
reason: Stale case - behavior OK: known build-vs-spec gap (case body itself flags it). No modal, but deletion is correctly prevented via menu-hide + disabled Delete button with tooltip. Not logged.

title: After reassigning the assigned user(s), the role can be deleted
expected: Reassignment succeeds; Users column shows 0; three-dot Delete + confirm deletes the role
actual: Reassigned Tech from ZZAUTOTEST Delete Blocked to Technician (POST /api/staff/{id}/change 201). Roles list Users column for the role then read 0, and its three-dot menu now showed 'View Permissions' + 'Delete' (Delete reappeared once count hit 0). Clicked Delete + confirm -> green toast 'Role deleted successfully.' and row disappeared.
reason: After reassigning the assigned user, Users count dropped to 0, the Delete option returned, and the role deleted successfully.

title: System roles have no Delete option anywhere in their actions
expected: Administrator, Office, Time Clock User show only eye icon (no three-dot); other 8 editable system roles show pencil+eye+three-dot; no three-dot menu contains Delete
actual: Checked all 11 system rows. NO system role exposes a Delete option anywhere (core intent satisfied): the 9 editable system roles (Admin, Service Manager, Senior SA, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Manager, Parts Tech, Sales Representative) show pencil + three-dot, and each three-dot menu contains ONLY 'View Permissions' (no Delete); Office and Time Clock show lock + eye only (no three-dot). However spec step-2 details are stale: Administrator is EDITABLE in this build (pencil+three-dot), not eye-only; there are 9 editable system roles not 8; and editable rows have no separate eye icon (View Permissions lives inside the three-dot menu).
reason: Stale case - behavior OK: no system role exposes Delete anywhere (the case's primary assertion holds). Icon-layout expectations are outdated (Admin now editable; 9 not 8 editable; View Permissions in menu). Not logged.

title: User-assignment count is accurate when deletion is blocked
role_used: Admin on ZZAUTOTEST Delete Blocked (1 user)
expected: Per spec: Cannot Delete modal states accurate assigned-user count ('assigned to N user(s)')
actual: With exactly 1 user (Tech) assigned, the disabled editor 'Delete Role' button message read 'This role is assigned to 1 user(s). Reassign them to another role before deleting.' - the count (1) is accurate (matches actual). Shown in the disabled-button tooltip/message, not a modal.
reason: Stale case - behavior OK: count is accurate (1) but surfaced in the disabled Delete Role button tooltip, not a Cannot Delete modal (no modal exists in build; same gap as 26351). Not logged.
